title: INDIVIDUALIZED RISK ASSESSMENT OF PREOPERATIVE OPIOID USE BY INTERPRETABLE NEURAL NETWORK REGRESSION
summary: An interpretable neural-network regression model estimated preoperative opioid-use risk in a 34,186-patient surgical dataset and reported patient-level associations.
ai_technology: INNER, an interpretable neural-network regression model, estimates preoperative opioid-use risk.
organization: Department of Biostatistics, University of Michigan, Ann Arbor.

evidence.tested: Methods describe repeated train/test splits and balanced subsampling; Results compare INNER with neural-network/logistic baselines and report risk factors.
